svg.aria-label: Validation happens at load: a malformed YAML file, a step with no capability, a duplicate name, a dependency on a step that does not exist, a cycle, or a template referencing a step missing from its depends_on all raise PipelineError before any job is submitted. Only a graph that passes is split into execution layers, each layer running concurrently.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: rejected before a single job is submitted

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: load_pipeline() refuses a bad graph at parse time, so a broken pipeline never burns provider time finding out
